entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Ah...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: [fName], what a coincidence.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We were just doing a bit of shopping.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But soon, we're going to celebrate[n]our dad receiving the superintendent[n]general award!
Your dad is?
That's unbelievable.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Come on, Makoto, you don't need to[n]raise your voice over it.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Remember Dad telling you earlier to[n]just act like it's no big deal?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm sorry, I couldn't help it...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm just so thrilled for him—it's like he's[n]finally getting the recognition that he[n]deserves.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Well, I do feel the same way.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: So, what groceries do we need to pick up[n]before we head home?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I wonder what Dad would like me[n]to cook...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I made eggplant miso soup for your[n]birthday...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: You had fried mackerel on yours, right?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I can still remember how you pestered[n]Dad about it until he cooked it for you...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Sis!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I didn't pester him! He asked me what[n]I wanted to eat for my birthday!
The two of them are[n]beaming with joy...
It seems this reality is the[n]one that Makoto wished for...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Ooh, I just had an idea! [fName],[n]would you like to join us for dinner[n]tonight?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh— I guess I don't know what we're[n]having yet, though...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Don't you think it's possible he already[n]has plans by now?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Look at you, Little Miss Outgoing![n]Where'd this turnabout come from?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Eh?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh! No, no! That's not what this is!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That reminds me, [fName]—what brings[n]you out here?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Sorry to keep you like this, by the way.
It's all right.
I came to see you.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Are you sure? Well, that's good...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Me? Is something the matter?
Enjoying the family time?
You seem very happy.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hm? Well, of course...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Uh— Yes? You think so?
You and Sae getting along?
Has your dad been supportive?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yes, just as well as always. Even when[n]she's busy at work, she always has my[n]back.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I couldn't thank her enough for all the...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: My dad? Of course.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: He's done such a great job as a single[n]parent, and...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Wait... Something's wrong.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Mom died... so Dad raised us alone...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...and Sis...
You're so close...
I'll be waiting for you.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Wait, what are you saying?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But... I'll be okay.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...I finally found a place where I belong.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I just...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Makoto? What's wrong?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh... No, I'm sorry. It's nothing.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Sorry, [fName].

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We have more shopping to do.[n]I'll see you later.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Sorry about that. We'll chat again soon.
...It seems all I can[n]do now is wait.
I guess I should head home...
